subject: reasoning
question: In a code language, "let us go shopping'' is written as '3228', 'make one list' is written as '434', 'the cart is filled' is written as '3426'. What is the code for the phrase 'pay by cash or card' in this language?
solution:
The logic followed here:

**Code = No. of letters in each word are written together**

 
• 'let us go shopping' is written as '3228'

 
 
• ​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e81e6e5a58cb171b3acca44bd235da49be01cc330621d74c7d8fdbc54248b2fa.png] 
 
 
 
• 'make one list' is written as '434'
 
 
• ​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e011bb9a50fa37ac044e65e6b421bf053cc68c9b428e1f73877c04cc6162ea4.png] 
 
 
 
• 'the cart is filled' is written as '3426'
 
 
• ​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b24ac5244f42121b4a880a02bf51c679d70aa1fd5e14c508ddf1e4aee9b5c57.png] 
 
 
 
• 'pay by cash or card' will be written as
 
 
• ​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/605df9849c2353c44c8c44c2500b0efe6db630e1f1853402e2a1eb70c6de92b7.png] 
 
 

Hence, '**32424' **is the correct answer.
